# hub-flash

Flashing a board: esptool over the cable, OTA over WiFi, chunks over the command channel, and images sent from another PC.

## Rules and traps

- `hub_flash.py` reads main.py's names late (`_hub.dev_cmd`, `_hub.FIRMWARE_DIR`): QC swaps them. See hub.md.
- A cable flash must WAIT until the hub really let go of the port (usb_free), not sleep: 21% then dead, bench 2026-08-20.
- OTA sends only firmware.bin; the board needs a login and the md5, or it refuses.
- Checks need a built image: a fresh staging has no firmware/.pio, so `--no-build` runs crash here.
